output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the owner calls mintToken, the balanceOf and totalSupply variables are updated without a check, allowing the owner to set these values to a very high amount, granting arbitrary tokens to the owner.

The transfer function allows the owner to transfer tokens from the user's account to any address, including the owner's, without any restrictions, allowing the owner to steal funds from user accounts.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the user calls sell, the amount * price is calculated, where amount is a user controlled value. If the amount is large enough, the resulting value will be less than the user's balance, allowing the user to buy more tokens than they have.
